ruleDefinitions.name: Indirect Inline Command Execution Via Bash.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects execution of Microsoft bash launcher with the "-c" flag.
This can be used to potentially bypass defenses and execute Linux or Windows-based binaries directly via bash.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\bash\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\bash\\\.exe$")) OR process_original_file_name = "Bash\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*"))
